Marta L: Heads up — nightly h100 warmup on hetero pool started failing around 02:30 UTC, multiple warmup jobs hit OOM during kv-cache allocation :sob:
Sam P: ok can you paste the warmup error/log snippet? cc eng-ml
ci-bot: [CI] job 12345 failed during warmup. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/12345/logs (exit: OOM)
Marta L: here's the relevant tail from the log:
```
[warmup] kv_cache_reserve(2147483648) failed
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
GPU 0: memory spike during beam search warmup
CUDA driver reported: 525.85, CUDA toolkit: 12.2
Backtrace: libruntime.so +0x1a3f2, libkernel.so +0x0ff21
```
Arya K: hmmm driver 525.85 — we rolled a driver canary last night. ops, did that roll hit the hetero warmup nodes?
ops: yep, we pushed 525.85 to warmup-hetero tag on a subset of racks at 00:40 UTC. only ~30% of pool.
Sam P: could be concurrency-related. can we rerun one failing shard with fewer warmup threads (NUM_WARMUP_THREADS=1) to see if it repros?
Marta L: yes please. command I used was:
```
ci rerun --job 12345 --shard 7 --env "NUM_WARMUP_THREADS=1" --nodes warmup-hetero-3
```
ci-bot: rerun queued -> https://ci.internal/runs/12346 (requested by Sam P) :white_check_mark:
Arya K: also add `RUNTIME_DEBUG=kv_alloc_trace` and `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0` to force single-GPU warmup and capture allocator timeline.
Sam P: I'll watch 12346 and compare memory traces. if it doesn't repro with threads=1, likely concurrent allocation bug or driver regression.
ops: I'll also spin one canary node back to driver 525.60 (warmup-canary-7) for a diff test, will label nodes accordingly.
Marta L: added label `rerun-request` on the CI run and pinned logs in the run comment.
Sam P: volunteering to run a small bisect across 525.60 -> 525.85 if reruns reproduce. can someone grant me access to the warmup-canary nodes? :raised_hands:
ops: granted `warmup` role to Sam P, and reserved warmup-canary-7 for comparison at 03:10 UTC.
Arya K: if both reproduce, we should open a driver-compat bug and include the kv_alloc_trace + dmesg + nvcrash dumps.
Marta L: ack — thanks everyone. I'll post updates in this thread after 12346 finishes. :thumbsup:
